environment.description: Flask application deployed on an EC2 instance behind an Application Load Balancer with a basic HTTPS listener. The ALB forwards all traffic on port 443 to the target group on port 8080. No WAF is attached to the ALB. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The application runs as a systemd service under a dedicated user account. SQLite database is stored locally at /var/app/data/users.db with read-write permissions for the app user.
